name: Human Standard
desc: A crimson masthead and real street photography turn AI nerdwear into a confident clothing label. Shopping gets the first word; art gets the second.
highlights: Product and price in the opening screen
Generator and art below the collection

name: Open Studio
desc: A cobalt studio directory and a workbench composition put finished garments next to the art practice. It feels like visiting the people behind the label.
highlights: Studio directory on desktop; working menu on mobile

name: Hallucination Club
desc: A punchy yellow club identity with a product selector built into the opening spread. Belonging comes from the shared joke, with no signup between you and a tee.
highlights: Oversized type with a wearable hero
Generator treated as a club creative activity

name: After Hours
desc: A cinematic contact sheet with warm white type and a single crimson purchase accent. Real garments and quiet photographic pacing replace ambient tech effects.
highlights: Product photography stays legible in dark mode
Shared accessible options and bag flow

name: The Living Index
desc: The storefront opens directly on the collection. A compact manifesto, clear filters, and an optional studio drawer make this the shortest route from curiosity to a piece.
highlights: Art and generator in a compact studio module
